estimates_note: Every figure is an estimate from the statistics of the window. Weight and read cost are an upper bound of the time the statements spend today: an index cannot remove more than all of it. Sizes come from the planner's row counts. A suggestion is a candidate to evaluate, never an instruction; pglens does not run it.

suggestions.create_statement: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_res_partner_ref ON public.res_partner (ref);

statements.query_text: SELECT id FROM res_partner WHERE ref = $1
